_comment: Search preferences and answer bank, derived from the master resume. Safe to commit — no secrets here. This is your main tuning surface.

profile.name: Anurag Verma
profile._linksComment: TODO before Phase 6: real URLs. The resume renders these as link text, so the URLs are not recoverable from the PDF.
profile._experienceComment: 1 yr full-time (RBH, Oct 2025-present) + 1 yr internships (Zalco 2023, Flix Logix 2024). Filtering uses full-time (1) since most postings mean full-time; the AI prompt is given both so it can credit the internship work on borderline roles.

search._skillsComment: requiredSkills is scored as 'at least N present', not all — see filter.minRequiredSkillMatches. Every entry below is genuinely on the resume.
search._excludeComment: Matched against the job TITLE only, so a description merely mentioning React does not disqualify a backend role.
search._rangeComment: Postings asking up to 3 yrs are reachable when internships are credited. 4+ was letting through roles wanting a solid mid-level engineer. 0 keeps new-grad and SDE-1 roles in.
search._locationComment: Remote entries must still be India-eligible; 'Remote, United States' is rejected by the filter's region check.

filter._matchComment: How many requiredSkills must appear in the description. 2 is deliberately loose — postings rarely list a full stack, and the AI judges the rest.

blocklist._comment: Companies the bot must NEVER auto-submit to. Surfaced for manual handling instead. Put your dream companies here.

platforms._comment: tier1 = automated submission allowed. tier2 = discovery only, never log in. See PRD.

boards._comment: Company board slugs to poll. All verified live. Global remote-friendly boards added — Indian product companies (Razorpay/PhonePe/Swiggy/Zomato) use Darwinbox/Keka/in-house portals with no public API; see NOTES.md.

answerBank._comment: Standard application questions. Anything not matched here routes to needs_manual — the bot never guesses.
answerBank._yoeAnswerComment: Application forms ask total relevant experience, where internship work legitimately counts. The filter uses 1 (full-time) to stay conservative; forms get 2.
answerBank._blankComment: Deliberately blank: these need a per-application answer or none. A blank value routes to needs_manual rather than being guessed.
